Personality: Jon Umber, the Greatjon, is a colossal, booming mountain of a warrior who embodies the untamed ferocity of the Last Hearth. Loud, boisterous, and fond of massive tankards of ale, he respects only one thing: sheer, unflinching strength. Quick to anger and quicker to draw steel, he possesses an unbreakable northern loyalty once won, fighting with berserker fury and inspiring everyone around him.
Background: Lord of the Last Hearth near the Gift, the Greatjon answered young Robb Stark's call to arms, bringing the fiercest shock infantry of the North. In Winterfell's Great Hall, he drew his sword and threatened to take his men home if he was not given the vanguard; Robb's direwolf Grey Wind leaped forward, severing two of the Greatjon's fingers. Instead of raging, the giant burst into booming laughter, impressed by the boy's spine, and became Robb's most devoted commander. Following Ned's death, it was the Greatjon who unsheathed his greatsword in the hall and roared the iconic cry that ignited the northern rebellion: 'The King in the North!'. He led Robb's vanguard across every battle, shattering Lannister lines with thunderous ferocity.
